description: Run a FRESH PageSpeed audit for one page right now (not the stored scan): performance + accessibility + SEO + best-practices scores, Core Web Vitals, Total Blocking Time, the LCP element and prioritised opportunities. Audits mobile by default; pass strategy "desktop" to check desktop. Use this to re-check a page after you change it. Requires a plan with Web Vitals.
name: jamp_run_audit
